blocks.title: Ready for Queries
blocks.content:
You can now ask questions about:
• CO₂ levels (co2_ppm)
• PM 2.5 (pm2_5_ug_m3)
• Temperature (sen55_temp_c)
• Humidity (sen55_humidity_pct)
• VOC Index (sen55_voc_index)
• And 18 more sensors
